description: The lessons check, as a nudge. In a repo whose PLAYBOOK.md has '## The lessons check', an edit, a git commit or a git push is denied until Claude has written a visible 'Lessons checked:' line in this turn (a background task's notification carries on the turn before it), after its last commit or push, and, in the session's own repo, where its dev/lessons.mjs is this plugin's version, run a lookup with it. After an Edit, Write or MultiEdit of LESSONS.md, PLAYBOOK.md or a rule file in such a repo, a second hook tells Claude what --lint finds in that file, in at most 10 lines, and, for a lesson an Edit or MultiEdit adds, the open lessons and steps its rule overlaps. It runs this plugin's own templates/lessons.mjs in its own process and never blocks. In other repos both do nothing. They read the target repo's files and the session transcript, write nothing and start no program. Any error lets the call through, but the gate denies a call whose own record it can't find in the session's transcript within 1.3 seconds, and once 6 seconds have passed it denies the call at its next look at the clock, since Claude Code runs a call whose hook its 10 second timeout ends. LESSONS_GATE=off turns both off.
